text:
My heart rejoiceth in the Lord, and my horn is exalted in my God.
My mouth is enlarged over my enemies: because I have rejoiced in thy salvation.
There is no one holy as the Lord; for there is none besides thee, and there is no strength like our God.
Talk no more so high: let pride depart from your mouth.
For the Lord is a God of knowledge, and to him are weighed all his actions.
The bow of the mighty is broken, and they that stumbled are girded with strength.
The needy are filled with good things, and the rich have been sent empty away.
The Lord killeth and maketh alive, bringeth down and lifteth up.
The Lord raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill.
To sit with the princes, and to possess the throne of glory.
The Lord will judge the ends of the earth, and he shall give empire to his king, and shall exalt the horn of his Christ.
